description: Paired control for covid_first_look_v6: identical grid, seeds and cabin compartments, with per-pathogen pool transport held at the labelled pre-change baseline (hvac.pathogen_pool_transport: none), so no airborne mass crosses a zone boundary for SARS-CoV-2. v6 differs from v5 in two things at once - the pools now ride the airflow network, and the transport step no longer creates mass - and this arm isolates the first: v6 minus v6c at the same (Theta, seed) is the contribution of between-zone ducted air to the Diamond Princess outbreak on the repaired transport numerics. Full grid rather than three points because the v6 selection is not known in advance; the arm attributes a difference and does not select a value.

grid.note: Half-decade points from 1e7 to 1e12, identical to v6 and v5.

held_out.note: Stored for the same pairing against v6 on the held-out hull (seconds a cell); not scored.
